text:
karan: Heads-up — deploybot scheduled the v2 rollout to us-east-1 for 21:00 UTC. Main change is header case normalization in mobile SDK. Quick preflight: canary + prober run at 20:30?

deploybot: Scheduled rollout id=rb-2026-03-21-01 -> v2 -> us-east-1. Canary: 5% traffic for 30m. To pause run: `/deploybot pause rollout rb-2026-03-21-01`

maria: running prober now against canary proxy. seeing auth failures from a subset of mobile probes (401). not everywhere, ~8/120 probes.

taylor: log snippet from the failing probe: ```
ERR auth: header "X-Client-Version" received as "x-client-version" -> svc rejects -> 401
agent=mobile-sdk-ios, region=iad, req_id=abcd1234
```

ashley: that matches the header-case change. mobile SDKs that don't casefold will break. we shipped the server stricter parsing to avoid duplicates — oversight.

james: what thresholds do we set for pause/rollback? we usually pause at >0.5% error uplift over 10m. given auth 401s, maybe lower?

karan: let's be conservative. pause if 0.25% error uplift in any region for 5m for mobile clients. also we can target a partial rollback for only mobile route if needed.

maria: opsbot probe summary (last 10m): failed_probes=9/120, regions=[iad,cle], error_types=[401:8, 503:1]

opsbot: Metric snapshots -> 10m: request_rate=8.2k/s, p95_latency=42ms, error_rate_global=0.08%, mobile_error_rate=0.35%

ashley: i can push a small header-normalize shim on the edge to accept either case. takes ~25m to build/test+canary. would that avoid rollback?

james: if shim is quick and safe, prefer shim + pause rollout for 30m while we validate. Avoid full rollback if not necessary.

karan: agree. patch + hold. docs-team please prep release notes blurb about header case normalization and migration tips. short snippet for SDKs.

docs-team: will draft; will include migration steps and a note about backward-compatible servers. ETA 30m.

maria: prepping a canary re-run after shim. re-run command: `curl -H "X-Client-Version: 1.2.3" https://canary-us-east.api.redwood.internal/ping` — i can script 200 mobile-like probes.

(taylor reacts :thumbsup:)

karan: ok deploybot, pause the rollout until we say otherwise: `/deploybot pause rollout rb-2026-03-21-01 --reason "prober auth failures - hold for shim"`

deploybot: Rollout rb-2026-03-21-01 paused by karan. status=PAUSED. Notifying operators.

maria: shim merged to edge branch, starting 5% canary deploy to us-east-1-edge. should be in traffic in ~6m.

opsbot: edge-canary health: p95=45ms, errors=0.02% (initial). will report 5m summary.

(taylor): quick question — do we need to update client header docs AND the release notes? we should keep both but different audiences.

docs-team: yes — short release-note blurb + detailed migration doc linked. i'll push the RN short blurb to the release-notes channel now.

maria: re-run mobile prober against shimmed canary: results -> 2/120 failures (transient), mobile_error_rate=0.02% over 10m.

karan: great. ops, can we keep the global rollout paused for a 2-hour observation window, then resume if metrics stable? set automatic resume to manual (no auto-resume).

james: agreed. set rollback criteria if mobile_error_rate >0.5% sustained for 5m after resume. also immediate rollback if 503 spike >1% in any region for 3m.

ashley: will follow up with a small patch release note and a test to ensure SDKs casefold headers by default.

deploybot: Rollout held. Note: operator note attached. To resume: `/deploybot resume rollout rb-2026-03-21-01`

karan: final checklist: 1) docs RN pushed (docs-team) 2) edge shim canary looks good (maria) 3) hold global rollout 2h manual resume 4) rollback thresholds set (james) 5) post-mortem if we see spike after resume

(maria reacts :white_check_mark:)

ashley: will open a tiny follow-up PR to make header handling explicit (link posted in thread).

karan: thanks all. we'll re-evaluate at 22:30 UTC or earlier if anything changes.

docs-team: release note blurb posted: "v2 rolling now includes header name normalization. Mobile SDKs that assume case-insensitive headers should continue to work; see migration guide for older SDKs."

(taylor): noted for release notes: please also add a 'what to do if you see 401' short FAQ.

karan: copied. closing action items in 2h unless we unpause. thanks everyone. :pray:
